phrases.text: Everyone has a theory about Pirate Shop Access. Here's what Epic actually says.
The Token Compass? Not real. There is no such thing.
Wearing a One Piece skin? Your skin has no effect on your odds.
Lucky chests? Nope. Everyone has an equal chance. Just open chests.
And Treasure Hours are tomorrow, with boosted odds. Get your squad ready!
Which myth did you fall for?
Use code BAD in the Item Shop. It really helps the channel.
Thank you for watching! Follow for more daily content.
